purchase_price.evidence: Trivo Orongo unit list: Unit 10 estudio piso 1, Precio $49,912, Área 44.39 m², balcony 9.32m². Pre-sale / under construction (developer materials cite 2025 construction; scout notes H2 2026 delivery). Parking sold separately.

monthly_rent.evidence: Largest screened Orongo studio (44.39m² piso 1 with 9.32m² balcony). Still inland student LTR product. FazWaz 1BR median ~$419; used $425 (range $375-500) vs smaller siblings at $400.

hoa_monthly.evidence: No alicuota published. Amenities are modest vs oceanfront towers: private urbanization, 24/7 security, access hall, green areas, TAG access — no pool/gym listed. Likely lower than amenity towers ($30-80/mo plausible) but unverified. Must obtain from developer.

special_assessments.evidence: Pre-sale/incomplete building — no HOA assessment history exists yet. Cannot verify future special assessments.

property_taxes_annual.evidence: Ecuador impuesto predial is 0.025%-0.5% of cadastral value (typically well below market). Comparable Manta condos often pay $100-400/yr. For ~$49,912 market price, estimated $40-149/yr; used $59. Exact bill depends on Manta municipal rate and cadastral assessment.

insurance_annual.evidence: Building structure insurance is typically included in Ecuador alicuota. Owner contents/liability: ~$140-210/yr base; Manta coastal earthquake risk adds 15-20%. For ~$49,912 condo, estimated $200-400/yr supplemental owner policy; used $225.

management_annual.evidence: Ecuador long-term property management typically 8-15% of rent. At $425/mo, 10% = $510/yr. Self-management possible with local presence (would be $0).

utilities_annual.evidence: For long-term Ecuador rentals, electricity/water/internet are typically tenant-paid. For STR, utilities are usually recovered in nightly rates or included in management fee. Owner direct cost assumed $0 under standard lease; if owner-paid budget $600-1,500/yr.

other_expenses_annual.evidence: Low-maintenance studio product per developer. Parking purchased separately (capital, not opex). Misc reserves ~$150/yr estimated.

rental_restrictions.evidence: Developer marketing explicitly targets rental income (student/professional demand near PUCE). Bylaws not published; rental use appears intended but not legally verified.

str_restrictions.evidence: Marketing mentions Airbnb as an option on some reseller pages, but building bylaws unavailable. Inland student-oriented product may face HOA/neighbor pushback on STR even if city regulation is Low. Confirm STR permission with developer. LTR is the underwriting base case.

notes: Orongo Unit 10: pre-sale cluster candidate. Delivery risk (construction ~2025 / H2 2026). HOA unknown. Parking not included. Rent path is student/professional LTR, not oceanfront STR. Sibling units share expense assumptions.
